articles.title: Report: 26 US sites across Middle East damaged in Iranian attacks
articles.summary:
Report: 26 US sites across Middle East damaged in Iranian attacks

Over 115 strikes claimed by Iran or groups aligned with Tehran have damaged 26 military bases and other infrastructure belonging to the US across the Middle East, The Associated Press reported. 

The analysis, using satellite imagery, indicated that Iranian attacks on US sites in the region have mostly targeted early-warning systems, aircraft and buildings, resulting in billions of dollars’ worth of damage to US equipment.

Watch: Mosque torched in northern Israel, graffiti sprayed on walls

A mosque was set on fire, and Hebrew graffiti calling for revenge was sprayed on its walls in the Palestinian village of Ed-Dahi in northern Israel on Thursday.

Palestinian citizens described the incidents as acts of "terror", which they also said came after weeks of escalating incitement against their community following record voter turnout and electoral gains in last month’s elections.

articles.title: US Senate blocks Iran war powers resolution
articles.summary: The US Senate on Thursday blocked a war powers resolution directing President Donald Trump to withdraw American forces from hostilities with Iran, Anadolu reports. The upper chamber voted 48-51 against adopting the measure, H.Con.Res. 93. Three Republican senators — Susan Collins, Lisa Murkowski and Rand Paul — broke with most of their party to support the resolution. Sen. John Fetterman was the only Democrat to vote against the measure, while Sen. Chris Murphy did not vote. In September, the House of Representatives approved the measure, which was sponsored by Democratic Rep. Seth Moulton, by a vote of 220-204. articles.summary: Israeli warplanes carried out five airstrikes on a mountainous area in eastern Lebanon on Thursday, while additional airstrikes, drone attacks and artillery shelling targeted several towns in the south, according to Lebanese state media. Lebanon’s official National News Agency (NNA) said five strikes hit the Al-Shaara area in the Anti-Lebanon mountain range, near the outskirts of Janta village in the eastern Baalbek district. archive.security_status_en: The security situation in the region remains critical due to ongoing clashes in the Persian Gulf, escalating tensions surrounding Iran's nuclear program, and active operations in Gaza and the West Bank. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has vowed to challenge the blockade, while mounting international sanctions and domestic political instability further strain the Israeli and regional economies.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další diplomatické manévry ohledně íránského jaderného programu a zvýšenou ostražitost v oblasti Perského zálivu. Konflikt v Gaze a napětí na Západním břehu budou nadále vyvolávat mezinárodní tlak a ovlivňovat trhy.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further diplomatic maneuvering regarding Iran's nuclear program and heightened vigilance in the Persian Gulf are expected. The conflict in Gaza and tensions in the West Bank will continue to generate international pressure and influence markets.

archive.security_status_cs: Region čelí eskalaci na více frontách, včetně nových přímých střetů a íránských útoků na americká a spojenecká zařízení v Perském zálivu. Izrael pokračuje v pozemních operacích v Gaze a úderech v Libanonu, zatímco vnitřní napětí roste kvůli útokům na mešity a incidentům na Západním břehu.
archive.security_status_en: The region faces multi-front escalation, including new direct clashes and Iranian attacks on US and allied facilities in the Persian Gulf. Israel continues ground operations in Gaza and strikes in Lebanon, while domestic tensions rise due to mosque arson attacks and West Bank incidents.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující napětí v oblasti Perského zálivu kvůli incidentům s tankery a zvýšenou pohotovost izraelských i spojeneckých sil. Diplomatické úsilí a vnitřní politické tlaky v Izraeli a USA zůstanou vysoce aktivní.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued tension in the Persian Gulf due to tanker incidents and heightened readiness of Israeli and allied forces are expected. Diplomatic efforts and domestic political pressures in Israel and the US will remain highly active.
